ticks.note: Tick 1: watching and running, motor stopped.
Demand: the motor starts (`starts` is 1). `quiet` counts the first tick without a beat.
A beat: `quiet` is 0 again. From now on no more beats arrive.

Third quiet tick: the watchdog emits `expired`. `Work` checks the abort after that emission and stops at once, in `Started`, with the motor on. `Watchdog` checked it before its own emission, so it carries on into `Expired`, and `Running` is not left.
`expired` was a signal, and it is gone. `Watchdog` sits in `Expired`, which never stops, so `Running` is never left: no `Safe`, no alarm.
The demand ends, but `Work` has stopped in `Started`, so nothing switches the motor off. `Running`'s exit action would, but `Running` is never left.
A beat changes nothing: the motor runs, and the alarm never comes.
